Veteran cultural organiser Soorya Krishnamoorthy dies at 78

Soorya Krishnamoorthy, a veteran cultural organiser and founder of the Soorya Stage and Film Society, has died at the age of 78. Born Nataraja Krishnamoorthy, he was previously a scientist at ISRO for over 20 years and worked with former Indian President APJ Abdul Kalam.
